data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The most discriminating evidence within a single evaluation is a mediation analysis: decompose the panel's aggregate score into checklist-driven variance and item-understanding-driven variance. A genuine reliability gain requires that the understanding-mediated path predicts outcomes independently of the checklist-driven path; mere compliance means the understanding path is near-zero and all predictive power flows through the checklist.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the checklist is perfectly diagnostic (all items perfectly predict outcome), there is no residual variance for understanding to explain, and the mediation test is uninformative.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If understanding operates entirely through the checklist\u2014i.e., understanding helps panelists apply the checklist correctly but produces no independent signal\u2014the mediation test will show zero understanding path even though understanding is causally important.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the evaluation sample is too small, the understanding coefficient will be estimated with high variance and the test will lack power.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Within one evaluation, we can measure (a) each panelist's raw item responses, (b) the checklist's keyed answers, and (c) the outcome. If we model outcome ~ checklist_score + understanding_residual, where understanding_residual is the part of the panelist's judgment not explained by the checklist key, then a significant coefficient on understanding_residual indicates the panelist brings independent feature-recognition ability. If the coefficient is near zero, the panelist is merely complying with the checklist and any reliability gain is reducible to the checklist's content, not the panel's competence. This is a causal mediation test: the checklist is the mediator, and the panelist's training is the treatment.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
